name: Jackfruit Chips
steps: Oil the knife and hands lightly; remove the jackfruit core and seeds, then cut the firm raw flesh into thin even strips.
Pat the strips very dry. Mix salt, turmeric and chili powder in a dry bowl for seasoning after frying.
Heat coconut oil in a deep pan. Fry jackfruit in small batches at medium heat, stirring so the strips separate.
Continue frying until the bubbling nearly stops and the jackfruit strips are fully cooked and crisp; lift out and drain on a rack.
Fry curry leaves briefly, toss them with the warm chips and dry seasoning, then cool fully before serving or storing airtight.
tips: Use firm unripe jackfruit; ripe sweet pods soften instead of becoming crisp.
notes: Quantities serve four adults. Check the doneness cues in each step and adjust seasoning to taste. Jain suitability depends on your household ingredient rules.
